steps.what: Show the stored failure note for this equipment.
Investigate equipment failures and recommend remedial actions.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the failure note already written for this equipment. An equipment id alone is not the note, and a missing note stops the screen. The mechanical engineer investigates the faulty operation and recommends the remedial action. Only the recommendation the engineer accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A remedy was filed from a part number, and the note of the faulty operation was empty.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored failure note can be opened. The investigation and the remedy still belong to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A cause the note does not describe still has to be found on the machine.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer investigates and recommends. The note is not the diagnosis.
tasks.altitude: The investigation stays with the engineer. The recommendation is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Write what the machine did before asking for a remedy.
reach.learn: An equipment id is not the failure.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored failure note is a lookup. An equipment id without that note does not diagnose the fault or recommend the action.
Filing a remedy before the engineer accepts that version would store an action nobody recommended.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The failure id and the failure note already written. An equipment id without the note stops the step. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the failure note in the document store. Do not start from the equipment id alone.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the mechanical engineer.
unknowns: Whether difficulties and hard failures share one note field.
research_questions: Who must write the failure note before an investigation starts?

already_counted.description: Investigating the failure and recommending the action stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop notes whose equipment record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: failure id and the remedial sentence the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still investigates the equipment failure and still recommends the remedial action. Only opening a failure note that was already written, and filing the recommendation already accepted, is removed. An equipment id with no note saves none of the diagnosis.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored malfunction of this machine or system.
Recommend design modifications to eliminate machine malfunctions.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the malfunction already recorded for this machine or system. The mechanical engineer recommends the design modification that would eliminate it. The record does not choose the modification. Only the recommendation the engineer accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A modification was copied from another machine and did not match this malfunction.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored malfunction can be opened. The modification still has to be recommended by the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A malfunction with more than one plausible change still has to be judged by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recommends the modification. The malfunction record is not the recommendation.
tasks.altitude: The recommendation stays with the engineer. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Draw a modification this engineer has accepted.
reach.learn: A malfunction title is not the design change.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored malfunction is a lookup. It does not recommend a design modification or eliminate the fault.
Filing a modification before the engineer accepts that version would store a change nobody recommended.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The malfunction id already stored. The modification text is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the malfunction record in the document store before writing the recommendation.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the mechanical engineer.
unknowns: Whether machine malfunctions and system malfunctions share one record.
research_questions: Who confirms the malfunction record matches the machine now in use?

already_counted.description: Recommending the modification stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop malfunction records whose machine has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: malfunction id and the modification sentence the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still recommends the design modification to eliminate the malfunction. Only opening the malfunction already recorded, and filing the recommendation already accepted, is removed. The record saves none of that judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored customer proposal, specification, or manual.
Research customer proposals and evaluate feasibility or maintenance requirements.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the customer proposal, specification, or manual already stored. The mechanical engineer researches it and evaluates feasibility, cost, or maintenance requirements. The document is not the evaluation. Only the evaluation the engineer accepts is filed. A cost that is not in the document is not invented.
tasks.previous_blocker: A feasibility line was filed from a proposal title, and the maintenance requirement was still unread.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored proposal can be opened. The research and the evaluation still belong to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A maintenance burden the proposal does not state still has to be judged by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer researches and evaluates. The proposal is the document already stored.
tasks.altitude: The evaluation stays with the engineer. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Price only a requirement this engineer has already accepted as in scope.
reach.learn: A proposal title is not the feasibility judgement.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored proposal, specification, or manual is a lookup. It does not evaluate feasibility, cost, or maintenance.
A cost that is not written in the held document is not invented. Filing the evaluation before the engineer accepts it would store a verdict nobody made.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The proposal id already stored. Cost and maintenance figures are used only when they are already in that document. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the proposal in the document store before the evaluation. Do not type a cost that is not in it.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the mechanical engineer.
unknowns: Whether manuals and proposals share one document type.
research_questions: Who confirms the proposal is the one the customer still stands behind?

already_counted.description: Researching the proposal and evaluating it stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop proposals the customer has withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: proposal id and the feasibility sentence the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still researches the customer proposal and still evaluates feasibility, cost, or maintenance. Only opening a document already stored, and filing the evaluation already accepted, is removed. A title saves none of that research, and a missing cost is not invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the customer question already logged.
Provide technical customer service in the conversation.

tasks.design: The {HELPDESK} shows the customer question already logged. The mechanical engineer provides the technical customer service in the conversation. The logged question is not that service. A question with no customer leaves the conversation with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A ticket was closed from the title, and the customer had not been spoken with.
tasks.enabler_now: The logged question can be opened. The service still takes the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: A technical point the ticket does not name still has to be heard from the customer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer serves the customer. The ticket is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: Customer service stays in the conversation. The logged question is visible and is not the service.

reach.task: Log what the customer asked before the engineer calls.
reach.learn: A ticket title is not the technical service.

evidence.claim: Opening a logged customer question is a lookup. It does not provide technical customer service.
A stored reply is not the conversation with the customer.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The question id only if it is already logged. The reply is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the question on the service desk before the conversation.
unknowns: Whether technical questions and general questions share one queue.
research_questions: Who confirms the caller is the customer on the question?

already_counted.description: The customer conversation stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop questions whose conversation has already happened.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still provides technical customer service in the conversation. Only opening a question that was already logged is removed. A question with no customer saves none of that service.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The mechanical engineer still investigates the failure, still recommends the modification, still judges the customer's design, and still serves the customer. A stored file can be opened. It does not make the call.
reach: Service technicians write the failure note, and this job learns a part number is not the diagnosis.
Account managers hear customer service from this engineer, and a ticket title is not that service.
skills_to_grow: Diagnose from the failure note and the machine, not from the equipment id alone.
Recommend a modification only after the malfunction is understood.
Evaluate feasibility in person, rather than treating the proposal text as the verdict.
role.ambitious_version: Diagnosis, modification advice, feasibility judgement, and customer service stay with the engineer. Stored notes only show what was already written.
